description: English version of the reference composition (mirrors ethalon.json v9: A. pantherina reworked — muscimol dominant, muscaridine and stizolobic acids added, Tsujikawa 2007 quantification; v8: one compound per entry, chemical-class field, class-grouped tables) for the judge (glm-5.3-flash, thinking low, via pi/zai) and for an English-language experiment: models will be asked about mushroom composition in English and their answers compared with the Russian-language run. Sources identical to the Russian version. Field keys mirror the Russian file; values are in English. Poorly supported facts are marked confidence: disputed/low.
